title: Ordinary Ambush damages wild and mounted Pokémon and uses one shared Jump knockback

verification.actor: Current Wild Snorlax and Ambush Weepinbell, with current mounted party Cyndaquil, on Route 29.
verification.trigger: After declared placement, allow the ordinary Weepinbell Ambush Hop to collide with Snorlax and later the mounted player. Do not force HP, motion, profiles, timers or RNG.
verification.observable: Native real Wild and party HP lose exactly 20 per accepted hit. The mount collision also reduces saved rider HP. Both target types use an airborne one-tile Jump, restore their normal height and control, retain a per-target 60-frame hit guard, and never hit the attacker itself.

setupMutations.change: Use private copies of test.nds/test.sav, teleport to map33 tile585,407, prepare level50 party Cyndaquil and mount it, spawn level50 Snorlax at585,405 and level10 Weepinbell at585,404, and bind all current generation-safe identities. Native motion and damage remain normal after setup.

limits: Prepared placement does not prove natural party selection, healing or wild population acquisition.
One bounded neutral input window must contain real collisions; missing HP loss or motion is a failure. No guest HP/motion writes supply the trigger.
Native completed queue poses and actual party/resident HP supply proof. No screenshots or video are captured.
This integrated case covers Wild and Mounted targets; the party-backed Follower role shares storage but has separate host storage checks.

events.value: Bind the current three actors and their full HP.
Observe normal Ambush collisions, real HP loss, and both Jump arcs.
Observe completed one-tile landings, per-target guards and restored mounted seat.

stop.condition: Both Wild and Mounted targets take one normal hit and finish one Jump, then20 clean tail frames; fail on missing identity, HP, profile, motion, field or control.

invariants: Each current target uses its real current and normal max HP
One attacking profile supplies fixed collision damage and Jump1 for both target roles
Wild and Mounted targets jump without stock walking knockback; the mounted rider and Pokémon share one anchor and restore seat height
